head_commit.message: Add config to disable /feedback (#8909) Some enterprises do not want their users to be able to `/feedback`. Adds to `config.toml`: ```toml [feedback] enabled = false ``` I've deliberately decided to: 1. leave other references to `/feedback` (e.g. in the interrupt message, tips of the day) unchanged. I think we should continue to promote the feature even if it is not usable currently. 2. leave the `/feedback` menu item selectable and display an error saying it's disabled, rather than remove the menu item (which I believe would raise more questions). but happy to discuss these. This will be followed by a change to requirements.toml that admins can use to force the value of feedback.enabled.
